text: Hey Jovert - welcome to the group! In terms of applying for a partnership visa with a same-sex marriage, it is almost exactly the same process as applying as it is for a heterosexual marriage - the only difference is a pretty minor difference at the very end of the process when it comes to applying for citizenship. We have detailed, step-by-step guides on our website - I recommend starting here: https://aic.org.il/the-gradual-process-birds-eye-view/  All the best!
